sites.context: Unpack the state-table byte into low-nibble State and high-nibble Action values.
sites.invariant: State and Action each remain exactly 16 tag-only variants with discriminants 0 through 15, so both masked nibbles are valid enum discriminants.

sites.context: Construct the bounded OSC parameter scratch array with uninitialized MaybeUninit elements.
sites.invariant: Every element has type MaybeUninit<&[u8]>, so the array itself may begin uninitialized before the used prefix is populated.

sites.context: Cast only the initialized OSC parameter prefix to borrowed byte slices for the synchronous callback.
sites.invariant: osc_num_params never exceeds MAX_OSC_PARAMS, every element in the selected prefix is initialized from a bounds-checked osc_raw range, and the borrowed slices do not escape osc_dispatch.
